about: The pending text rules the guard accepts. tests/test_no_text_rules.py requires every pending ledger key to be listed here and this list to hash to PENDING_BASELINE_SHA256. Growing it is a reviewed step: change this file and the hash in one commit and say why in the commit message. Removing a rule needs no change here.

recorded.step: initial baseline: the two pending A7 regexes the ledger held before the guard extension, re-keyed by (file, symbol, sink)
